Review Title: An amazing experience you cant miss with Uncle Mel
Review Text:
Grateful I found this tour in tripadvisor as this tour is so well planned, covered a lot of interesting locations, as well as handling inter-island flights too!

Our guide Uncle Mel is awesome! Super knowledgeable, not only about the tourists spots that we went, but also the culture and science that you would love to know! Such as talking about growing bananas, the wisdom of understanding nature making Kona a crop powerhouse, and many more.

As a hula dancer from Hong Kong, i am so thrilled to see all the beautiful scenery and be with the majestic volcano Kilauea. It is absolutely interesting to hear the 'Ohia tree story that Uncle Mel shared and see the tree real in front of me! Lehua blossom is always mentioned in the songs in the dances, seeing it and feeling its energy is a total different level of experience! So if you are a hula dancer too, or if you play hula music, you must join this tour and meet Uncle Mel!

The volcano park is such a gem and we are lucky to see the double rain in the misty rain! Another lucky thing was the Nene goose, we saw them multiple times!

This whole experience is unforgettabe and i cant wait to be back again! hope to see and learn from Uncle Mel again soon!
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Text:
I went on this tour and highly recommend it. The flights were very easy from Oahu and back from

Mel had a ton of history, culture and facts to offer at each stop and we had a very comfortable air conditioned bus taking us to multiple sites. This was well worth the price during a week long trip to Honolulu and I left the big island feeling much more educated and enlighten on the area. The volcano was the pivotal part of the tour and ended the day. This was a great experience!

Tips for others be prepared to walk and get in and out of the van many times. Bring extra water if possible and a good camera for numerous amazing shots of the local area.
